yes_no.title: Yes/No Quick Oracle
yes_no.subtitle: Meditate on a specific question (e.g., 'Should I take this job?'), and let the tarot give you direct guidance.

three_card.title: Three Card Timeline Spread
three_card.subtitle: One of the most classic spreads. Through the 'Past-Present-Future' timeline, it helps you understand the sequence of events and insight into potential trends.

daily.title: Daily Guidance
daily.subtitle_1: What does the universe want to tell you today?
daily.subtitle_2: Draw a card as your spiritual totem for the day.
daily.advice_content_upright: Today, try to embody the energy of {{card}}. Keep an open mind and let this positive quality guide your actions.
daily.advice_content_reversed: Today, try to embody the energy of {{card}}. Be careful not to fall into negative emotional cycles, stay aware.

reading.ai_mock_content: According to the spread, {{cardName}} reveals the core energy of this issue. {{themes}} Suggest keeping aware and listening to inner guidance.
